default.title: Real Shopify test-order management
default.summary: ClawPilot now has a tightly controlled development lane for real, auditable Shopify order changes while production provider writes remain disabled.
features: Authorized operators can add one exact Shopify order tag on an allowlisted development sandbox account, including fulfilled test-workflow orders such as order 6600
Fresh, wholly unfulfilled Shopify test orders can be cancelled or have an existing line quantity decreased or removed after exact provider eligibility checks
Every provider action uses a five-minute typed confirmation, immutable attempt evidence, exact readback, and read-only reconciliation for uncertain outcomes
fixes: Destructive changes require the accepted Shopify revision, matching store currency, coherent staged totals, and no downstream warehouse work
Planning, reservation, billing, and sandbox execution records cannot race an in-flight Shopify order write
Unknown or abandoned provider outcomes block further writes and appear in operational health instead of being retried or silently cleared
